title: Future iPhones will have one less button, new rumor claims
description: Apple introduced the Action button with the iPhone 15 Pro, and the iPhone 18 Pro still has it. Now, a tipster on Weibo claims the company is planning to combine the Action button and the Camera Control into a single button on next year's iPhones. The dedicated Action button will allegedly start disappearing from new iPhones in the second half of 2027. Its functions will move to the Camera Control, with a single press opening the Camera app and a long press triggering the shortcut assigned to the Action button. The tipster specifically stresses that it's the Action button going away, not...

title: Airbnb is building an AI travel agent that designs its own interface
description: Airbnb has spent much of 2026 folding AI into search, listing descriptions, and customer support. Now, in its Q3 2026 shareholder letter, the company says it's building a specialized AI agent meant to help guests plan and book trips, with a rollout planned for the first half of 2027. Airbnb doesn't think a traditional chatbot is the right way to plan a trip. Instead, it's developing a custom, AI-native experience that "builds the interface around your question." Rather than a chat window, the agent pulls from a library of hundreds of travel-specific elements - maps, photos, comparisons,...

title: Apple says over 100,000 apps are now optimized for the iPhone Duo
description: The iPhone Duo started shipping about two weeks ago, and app support has been one of the early talking points. Today, Apple claims there are already well over 100,000 apps built for the foldable live on the App Store, with thousands of optimized titles being added each day. [#InlinePriceWidget,13804,1#] Susan Prescott, Apple's vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations, says developers have moved quickly to embrace the handset. title: Samsung Display tipped to lead OLED supply for 2027 iPad Air
description: The latest versions of the iPad Pro and iPad mini already sport OLED screens, but the current 11-inch and 13-inch iPad Air are stuck with LCD panels. Today, industry sources in Korea are claiming that the first OLED iPad Air models are due in the first half of 2027 - which lines up with earlier reporting. These Korean sources put 2027 OLED iPad shipment outlooks at 3 to 4 million Pro units, 4 to 5 million mini units, and 4 to 5 million Air units. description: According to a new rumor, Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will stick to Snapdragon chipsets in South Korea, despite the Exynos 2700 reportedly outperforming Qualcomm's offering in internal tests. Tipster yeux1122 claims that Samsung's decision to use Snapdragon chipsets in its two upcoming flagships is driven by cost considerations, with the company focusing on reducing costs during the design and component selection process. title: Oppo's first gimbal camera is almost ready to take on DJI and Insta360
description: Oppo confirmed last September that it was working on a new form-factor imaging product line for release in 2026, and earlier this year Digital Chat Station said the project was internally known as Fuyao - a pocket gimbal camera meant to take on DJI's Osmo Pocket line. Today, the tipster says Fuyao should be arriving soon, and that there's high confidence about the product's success inside the company. In the replies, DCS adds that Oppo has lately been doing competitor analysis and that a launch doesn't feel too far off. The increasingly crowded pocket-gimbal space now also includes...

title: WhatsApp announces Events Home and shareable event invites
description: WhatsApp users can already create events in a 1:1 conversation and group chats. Now they can also create events that they can share with people who don't have a WhatsApp account. "Create an event, add a cover photo, share the link, and they can see details and RSVP without downloading the app," said WhatsApp in a blog post. The company also said your phone number won't be shown to event guests you don't know, and guests without a WhatsApp account will only see the event address after they RSVP. WhatsApp has also announced Events Home, a one-stop hub for creating and sending...

title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra has reportedly been cancelled
description: Oppo's Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max went global recently, and the Find X10 Ultra was expected to follow in the first half of next year as the camera-focused top dog. Today, Digital Chat Station on Weibo says Oppo's Ultra project is on hold. There's no reason given, but it's easy to guess that it all has to do with the insane memory prices which would have pushed the Find X10 Ultra to stratospheric levels, considering it was supposed to be a camera-centric flagship, and those cameras aren't cheap either. title: vivo also reportedly developing a wide-screen phone for 2027 launch
description: Since Huawei unveiled the Pura X View earlier this year, several Chinese smartphone brands, including Oppo, Honor, and most recently Xiaomi, have been rumored to be developing their own wide-screen phones. Now, a new leak suggests that vivo is also joining the race. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, vivo is targeting a 2027 launch for its first wide-screen candybar-style smartphone. title: Samsung Galaxy Fit4 might have NFC for payments
description: The Samsung Galaxy Fit3, launched in February 2024, is due for a successor. Rumors claim the Galaxy Fit4 will arrive this year, with recent leaks revealing its design and key features. There's no word from Samsung about the Galaxy Fit4's launch; however, it has published the Galaxy Fit4 Manager app on the Galaxy Store, and the screenshots in the listing hint at NFC support. One screenshot in the listing, attached below, shows a "Wallet" option in the app's menu. It's obscure and behind the bottom navigation bar. title: Honor 700 series design officially revealed, all models to include a rear display
description: Honor has officially unveiled the design, color options, and storage configurations of its upcoming 700 series in China. The lineup will comprise the Honor 700, Honor 700 Pro, and Honor 700S. All three models are confirmed to feature a rear display and are now available for pre-order through Honor’s official online store in China. Honor 700 and Honor 700 Pro While a launch date hasn’t been announced yet, the phones are likely to go official later this month. title: iQOO 16s gets certified and it's eerily familiar
description: The upcoming iQOO 16R received its first certification in Indonesia last month, and today it showed up in another database, but with a twist. Malaysia's SIRIM certification lists the model number I2606 as the iQOO 16s, not the 16R. That's the same model number that showed up as the iQOO 16R in the GSM Association's IMEI database and Indonesia's TKDN listing. So it looks like iQOO will sell this phone as the 16s at least in Malaysia, though it remains to be seen which name other markets will get. The SIRIM listing doesn't reveal any specs, unfortunately. title: Samsung Galaxy S27 is headed to India, new certification reveals
description: The Samsung Galaxy S27 has already made the rounds through several certification databases, and today it has passed through another one. The handset, bearing the model number SM-S952B/DS, has just been approved by India's Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), and it's the first member of the S27 family to get there. Unfortunately, the BIS listing doesn't reveal any specs, but we already know a fair bit from the phone's earlier appearances. title: Here's when Samsung's Android XR glasses finally go up for pre-order
description: Samsung showed off its first Android XR glasses at its Galaxy Unpacked event back in July, and a recent report claimed they would go on sale in mid-December. Now we know when you'll be able to pre-order them, and the news doesn't come from Samsung or Google, but from Warby Parker, which designed some of the frames. In its third-quarter results today, Dave Gilboa, Warby Parker's Co-Founder and Co-CEO, said that the company will begin accepting pre-orders for its first Intelligent Eyewear collection on November 12. title: WhatsApp is bringing iOS-style chat previews to Android
description: WhatsApp has long let you turn read receipts off entirely, but if you keep them on, there's no easy way on Android to see what someone sent you without them knowing you've read it. The notification helps, unless you've already swiped it away or have too many messages piling up. iPhone users have had a workaround for a while now, and it looks like Android users will finally get it too. On iOS, you can long-press a conversation in the chat list to get a pop-up with its most recent messages, and doing so doesn't trigger the blue ticks. title: Samsung's over-ear headphones said to be called Galaxy Studio, design details surface
description: Samsung’s rumored high-end over-ear headphones, reportedly called Galaxy Studio, are expected to launch in early 2027 alongside the Galaxy S27 series. A new leak now offers the first details about their design. A pair of Samsung headphones bearing the model number SMU700 have appeared on the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) certification website. These are said to be the rumored Galaxy Studio headphones. The listing includes an image showing the placement of the regulatory label, which also offers a partial look at the headphones. title: Sony brings back the original Walkman headphones with USB-C
description: Back in 1979, Sony launched the original Walkman TPS-L2 cassette player alongside the MDR-3 headphones, and together they helped popularize listening to music on the go. Today, the company is bringing those headphones back for the modern era with the MDR-3R, which keep the classic look but add USB-C. The MDR-3R faithfully recreate the original design, including the lightweight open-ear build and the iconic blue and orange ear pads, which you can swap around to match your mood. title: Counterpoint: global DRAM revenue grows by 369% in Q3
description: Global DRAM revenue has increased by an insane 369% year-over-year thanks to strong demand for the stuff, which goes towards building new AI accelerators and data centers. The Average Selling Price (ASP) has reached $1.9 per gigabit (i.e. 1/8th of a gigabyte). The big winner here is South Korea – Samsung is the biggest player with 38% market share, while SK hynix had a 29% share. SK’s revenue grew over 40% quarter-on-quarter, but things are going better for Samsung right now. US-based Micron holds the third spot with 21% share while China’s CXMT was fourth with 9% share.
